interface.name: 榜单与信号首页
interface.purpose_zh: 首页前三个位置展示榜单，后三个位置展示信号事件；榜单按关注分排序，信号显示发生了什么。
interface.purpose_en: Three board positions rank attention; three signal positions show what happened.
display_zh: 1：升温榜；2：最热榜；3：新发现榜（按系统首次建档时间）。
4—6：三个信号区域，具体分组和时间排序规则待定义。
三榜引用结果定义；信号引用5005通道定义，读取API与持久存储未绑定。
display_en: 1: Warming; 2: Hottest; 3: Newly discovered (first system registration time).
4–6: signal areas; grouping and time ordering remain undefined.
Three board result definitions; signals reference channel 5005. APIs and persistence remain unbound.
Scoring: 5007 → 3032 → score events. Alerts: 5007 → 3011–3015 → 5005. Alerts do not automatically add scores.
actions_zh: 当前只查看六框结构与来源定义；真实资产详情导航待实现。
actions_en: Inspect the six positions and their source definitions; real asset navigation is pending.
limitations_zh: 六框是结构预览，没有真实币、分数或信号记录。
榜单生成卡3017/3018/3019继续收起；结果表存在不证明已有榜单输出。
新发现榜使用统一建档UUID及首次创建时间，不恢复旧发现奖励；三类信号分组未定。
业务首页、读取API、信号持久化与回测尚未实现或核验。
limitations_en: Structure preview without real assets, scores or signal records.
Generators 3017/3018/3019 remain shelved; result definitions do not prove board output.
Newly discovered uses registered UUIDs and first creation time, without retired discovery rewards; signal grouping remains undefined.
Business page, read APIs, signal persistence and backtesting are unimplemented or unverified.
